_comment: Motion presets for Animation > Previews (pages/text_animator/motion.py). From the approved Presets Store design's preset tile: each channel is 41 samples spread over `dur` seconds (one value = constant). t = [dx, dy] in half-units of a 128x72 stage (x/64 and y/36 of the frame from its centre, y down), r = degrees clockwise, s = scale, o = opacity. keys = {channel: [[sample, value, left handle, right handle]]} drawn by hand where the samples were too coarse for the move (Drop's bounces, Tin's pulses, Tada's wiggle, Zoom's Out): those channels are played from the keys, the samples worked out from them.
